title: Beyond Repository Boundaries: Cross-Repository Graph Retrieval for Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.09987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repository-level code generation requires generated code to be compatible not only with the target repository but also with its dependency environment. Existing retrieval-based methods mainly retrieve context from the local repository, leaving external API usage dependent on the model's pretrained knowledge, which can be insufficient for unseen or version-specific APIs. Moreover, current retrieval strategies largely focus on one-hop evidence and overlook the structural relationships among code components. We propose CrossCoder, a cross-repository code generation framework that explicitly incorporates external libraries into the retrieval context through a unified knowledge graph over repository and library entities. CrossCoder identifies important nodes via planning and semantic retrieval, then selectively expands neighboring nodes to retrieve richer multi-hop contextual evidence for generation. translated_title: 超越仓库边界：面向代码生成的跨仓库图检索
translated_abstract: 仓库级代码生成要求生成的代码不仅与目标仓库兼容，还需与其依赖环境兼容。现有的基于检索的方法主要从本地仓库中检索上下文，使得外部API的使用依赖于模型的预训练知识，这对于未见过的或特定版本的API来说可能是不够的。此外，当前的检索策略主要关注一跳证据，忽视了代码组件之间的结构关系。我们提出了CrossCoder，一个跨仓库代码生成框架，它通过对仓库和库实体构建统一知识图谱，显式地将外部库纳入检索上下文。CrossCoder通过规划和语义检索识别重要节点，然后选择性地扩展相邻节点，以检索更丰富的多跳上下文证据用于代码生成。为了进一步评估依赖版本兼容性...
tldr: 该论文提出CrossCoder框架，通过构建覆盖仓库与外部依赖库的统一知识图谱进行多跳图检索，将外部库信息显式纳入代码生成上下文，解决了现有方法仅依赖本地仓库且忽视代码组件结构关系的局限。
en_tdlr: CrossCoder is a cross-repository code generation framework that incorporates external libraries into retrieval context through a unified knowledge graph spanning repositories and libraries, and leverages multi-hop graph retrieval to gather richer structural evidence, overcoming the limitations of local-only and one-hop retrieval methods.
